name: Branch Operations
description: The operational department responsible for managing daily branch activities including cash handling, ATM management, system connectivity, and security procedures.

name: Daily Operations Checklist
description: A documented operational control procedure that governs the opening and closing routines for branch operations, including cash vault verification, ATM stocking, system connectivity testing, security protocols, and end-of-day reconciliation.
rule_statement: Opening and closing checklists must be completed daily

name: ATM System
description: The automated teller machine system operated by the branch, requiring daily stocking, balance verification, and cash count procedures as part of branch operations.

name: Branch System Connectivity
description: The core banking system connectivity infrastructure tested daily during branch opening procedures to ensure operational readiness.
purpose: Enable system connectivity testing and verification

name: Cash Vault Verification
description: A mandatory opening procedure requiring verification of the cash vault to ensure security and accuracy of branch cash holdings.
rule_statement: Cash vault must be verified during opening checklist

name: Security Alarm Test
description: A daily operational control requiring testing of security alarm systems during branch opening and activation during closing procedures.
rule_statement: Security alarm must be tested during opening and activated during closing

name: Cash Reconciliation
description: A closing procedure requiring reconciliation of all cash holdings to ensure accuracy and completeness of branch cash management.
rule_statement: Cash reconciliation must be performed during closing checklist

name: End-of-Day Report
description: A mandatory closing procedure requiring the generation and submission of an end-of-day report documenting branch operations and reconciliation results.
rule_statement: End-of-day report must be completed as part of closing checklist

name: Cash Handling Procedures
description: Policy governing daily cash handling operations across branches, including limits, security protocols, and reconciliation requirements. Establishes the framework for cash management and dispute resolution thresholds.
rule_statement: Cash handling must follow established procedures including daily limits, vault security protocols, and end-of-day reconciliation

name: Daily Cash Limit per Branch
description: Maximum cash holding permitted at each branch location on a daily basis. This limit is enforced as part of cash handling procedures.
what_it_measures: Maximum cash holdings permitted at each branch location

name: Vault Security Dual Custody Requirement
description: Security control mandating that vault access and cash handling require two authorized personnel — a manager and an officer — to be present simultaneously. This dual custody arrangement mitigates fraud and theft risk.
rule_statement: Vault access and cash handling requires dual custody with both a manager and an officer present

name: Daily End-of-Day Cash Reconciliation
description: Mandatory daily reconciliation of cash holdings at end of business day (EOD) to ensure accuracy and detect discrepancies. Part of the Cash Handling Procedures policy.
rule_statement: Cash must be reconciled daily at end of business day

name: Branch Manager Dispute Resolution Approval Threshold
canonical_name: Branch Manager Dispute Resolution Approval Threshold
description: Decision authority permitting branch managers to approve dispute resolution for cash discrepancies below £1,000 without escalation. Disputes at or above this threshold require higher-level approval.

rule_statement: Branch managers may approve dispute resolutions up to £1,000 without escalation
